conviction_note: Findings sum to a small positive (+0.7): peer Q3 2026 releases show only small deposit-cost drift despite the 16 Sep Fed hike, buyback share-count accretion, and expense normalisation point to a steady-to-better quarter. Against that sit a liability-sensitive CD book now facing a hiking Fed (an outlook risk on the 22 Oct call) and Q2's Visa gain flattering the comparison. A 5.1% HoldCo activist stake and short interest up 54% since July add two-sided tail. There is no consensus to beat, and the name's beats have bought little (Q2 +24% EPS, +0.43%), so p_up is only 55 on an abs move of 2.3%. The scaled number (+0.23) is far below the findings' sum because p_up carries the unsourced bar and the damped reaction function.
bar: unsourced. No current Q3 2026 consensus found: MarketBeat (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/TRST/earnings/) shows no estimate for Q2 2026, Q1 2026 or Q3 2026, and Benzinga's fields are blank. The working bar is the run-rate, Q2 2026 diluted EPS of $0.98 (8-K ex99, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000357301/000114036126029118/ef20078312_ex99-a.htm). That figure includes an $844k pre-tax Visa conversion gain (about $0.04), so core is about $0.94-0.95. My trend estimate for Q3 is about $0.97-1.00. Every finding is capped small because of this. Expense guide is disputed: the sweep says $27.7-28.2m a quarter, the AI transcript of the Q2 call (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-21-trustco-bank-corp-ny-stock/) says $27.3-27.8m.
positioning_check: Short interest (Equibles/FINRA, https://equibles.com/stocks/trst/shortinterest): 1,222,398 shares at 2026-09-30 settlement, 7.2% of 17.03M shares outstanding, 7.86 days to cover. That is up from 795,185 (4.7%) on 2026-07-31 and 1,143,637 on 2026-09-15, so it is rising fast but is not at squeeze levels like 18-23% of float. The 2026-10-15 settlement is not yet published (due 10-26). There is no usable option chain (baseline options status empty_chain), so there is no skew. Tape: spot $54.48, 20-day run-up -1.91%, 5-day run-up +1.13%, 7.8% below the 52-week high. HoldCo Asset Management (bank activist) holds 5.1% via a 13D dated 2026-07-28.

findings.finding: Liability-sensitive peers that reported Q3 2026 after TrustCo last spoke show deposit costs barely moving despite the Fed's 16 Sep hike. Hingham (CD-heavy savings bank, 16 Oct): NIM +9bp q/q to 2.23%, interest-bearing deposit cost +3bp, interest-bearing liability rate +1bp. Independent Bank Corp: deposit cost +6bp, NIM +4bp. Regions: interest-bearing deposit cost +1bp. This supports TrustCo's NIM continuing its 2.84% (Q1) to 2.87% (Q2) climb in Q3 and net interest income above Q2's $45.6m. The market has no TrustCo-specific number for this.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 brought NIM +3bp q/q, NII +9.2% y/y and EPS +24% y/y, and the stock moved +0.43%. Q1 2026 brought a similar NIM story and -2.68%. NIM progress has bought little.
findings.why_not_priced: No analyst publishes a TrustCo Q3 NIM estimate (no consensus at all), so no one has transmitted peer deposit-cost readings into a TrustCo number. If it were priced, the stock would not sit 7.8% below its high with short interest rising into the print.
findings.independence: INDB 3Q26 release (https://s206.q4cdn.com/952898466/files/doc_earnings/2026/q3/earnings-result/INDB-3Q26-Earnings-Release.pdf) and Regions 3Q26 (https://finviz.com/news/403470/regions-reports-earnings-of-611-million-and-eps-of-071-in-3q-2026) point the same way. These are proxies, not TrustCo's own number.

findings.finding: Buyback share-count accretion: TrustCo bought 522,226 shares in Q1 and 479,141 in Q2 (10-Q equity statement). It has 1M shares left on its 2M-share 2026 program, which it says it is on pace to finish by year-end. At about 500k a quarter on about 17.0M shares, the average diluted count falls roughly 2.5-3% q/q, adding about $0.025-0.03 to EPS against Q2 at flat net income.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Buyback-driven EPS growth (Q2 EPS +24% vs NI +12.8%) bought +0.43% in July.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the program is public. The only unpriced part is that no published estimate carries the per-share arithmetic.
findings.independence: The Q2 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000357301/000114036126029118/ef20078312_ex99-a.htm) states the pace, but it is the same company source.

findings.finding: Q2's $0.98 headline EPS included an $844k pre-tax unrealised gain from converting Visa Class B-2 into B-3/C shares (about $0.04 per share after tax). Unless the unsold Class C shares produce another gain in Q3, a core improvement could print as flat headline EPS against $0.98 and read as a stall.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior TrustCo print turned on a one-off. Wire headlines lead with the y/y net income % ('12.8% increase'), so the headline comparison matters on a no-consensus name.
findings.why_not_priced: Aggregators show $0.98 as the Q2 actual with no adjustment. A headline comparator built off $0.98 would not strip the gain.
findings.independence: The Q2 call transcript (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-21-trustco-bank-corp-ny-stock/) confirms the $844k gain. Same company source.

findings.finding: The Fed raised the funds rate 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 16 Sep 2026. TrustCo funds with $2.25bn of time deposits (about 39% of $5.7bn deposits; Q2 time-deposit expense $18.9m), and on the Q2 call the CFO said it was trying to 'get away from the three-month repricings', which describes a short, fast-repricing CD book. The 22 Oct 9:00 call (inside the window) is likely to carry Q4 commentary that slows the 'continued NIM expansion' narrative. Q3 itself saw only two weeks of the hike.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: TrustCo gives only qualitative outlook. There is no recorded reaction to an outlook change. The worst recent print reactions were -2.95% (Jan 2025) and -2.68% (Apr 2026).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is 7.8% off its high and short interest rose 54% from July to September, consistent with a liability-sensitivity short. What is not priced is management's own read, which no one has heard since the hike.
findings.independence: The CFO's CD-repricing remarks are in the Q2 call transcript (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-21-trustco-bank-corp-ny-stock/). Time-deposit balances are in the 10-Q. Hingham's +3bp deposit cost cuts against the size, so this finding is held small.

findings.finding: Short interest rose from 795,185 shares (31 Jul) to 1,222,398 (30 Sep), 7.2% of shares outstanding and 7.9 days to cover on about 98k shares a day. A clean print with no NIM warning meets a growing, illiquid short.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Short interest was much lower at past prints (about 650-800k), so there is no history at this level.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the positioning itself, not a forecast. It matters only conditionally on the print not confirming the short thesis.

findings.finding: HoldCo Asset Management, a bank activist, filed a 13D on 28 Jul 2026 for 872,744 shares (5.1%). It says it is discussing 'opportunities to enhance shareholder value' with management, including capitalization and possible business combinations. On 15 Sep the board added two independent directors. With half the 2M-share 2026 buyback already done, the Q3 release or call could carry a new or larger authorization or capital-return step.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The August dividend raise (+5.3%) and the buyback acceleration have been announced off-print, with no isolated reaction measured.
findings.why_not_priced: The 13D is public, but nothing has been announced since apart from two board seats. A capital-return step at the print is optional and undated, so the price cannot carry it beyond a small option value. The stock is below its early-September $57 level, so no takeover premium is in it.
findings.independence: 8-K of 16 Sep 2026 on the board expansion (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/357301/000114036126036784/ef20082117_8k.htm). HoldCo's Feb 2026 presentation listed TRST as a 'soft activism' engagement (https://www.barchart.com/story/news/106804/holdco-asset-management-to-present-at-ubs-financial-services-conference-in-key-biscayne-florida-releases-presentation).

findings.finding: Expense normalisation: Q2 noninterest expense of $28.2-28.3m ran above the $27.3-27.8m quarterly guide (per the transcript). The CFO said professional fees 'won't continue to recur' and that stock-price-linked incentive comp would normalise. The stock fell from about $57 (2 Sep Form 4 price) to $54.5, so the incentive accrual should ease, a $0.5-0.9m pre-tax tailwind (about $0.02-0.04 per share).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2's expense overshoot (+$1.3m q/q) coincided with a +0.43% reaction, so the market did not punish it.
findings.why_not_priced: There is no consensus line to carry it. The guide itself is disputed between sources ($27.3-27.8m vs $27.7-28.2m), so it is small and inside the company's guide.
findings.independence: The Form 4 price of $57.34 on 2026-09-02 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/357301/000114036126035560/form4.xml) gives the stock path. Otherwise the same transcript.

baseline_tension: There is no option skew. The -1.9% 20-day and -7.8%-from-high tape plus a 54% rise in short interest say the market leans to a rate-hike/NIM worry. The peer deposit-cost evidence cuts mildly against that lean, while the Fed-hike outlook finding agrees with it, so the net is a small positive with p_up only 55.
